help.usage: ambitious-video <command> [--in file] [--db path] [--cache dir] [--offline] [--now ISO8601] [--seed int] [--json]
help.summary: Renders a video from a script written as YAML or JSON. Every command prints one JSON envelope on stdout and nothing else.

commands.name: guide
commands.summary: Print an example script to copy, and the steps to render it.

commands.name: validate
commands.summary: Check a script and the files it names. Reads a script.

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: List the steps with their step keys, the captions, the assets and the keys still needed (secretsNeeded) of a script. Reads a script.

commands.name: estimate
commands.summary: Price a script without calling a provider, and list the keys still needed (secretsNeeded). Reads a script.

commands.name: render
commands.summary: Render a script to a video file. Reads a script, or { "jobId": "..." } to retry a job.

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Check the video of a rendered job. Reads { "jobId": "..." }.

commands.name: jobs
commands.summary: List the render jobs in the database.

commands.name: ledger
commands.summary: List the cost lines in the database.

commands.name: cache list
commands.summary: List the entries of the step cache.

commands.name: cache prune
commands.summary: Remove cache entries last used more than --older-than <days> ago.

commands.name: selfcheck
commands.summary: Report the runtime, the database and the tools, with warnings for a missing tool.

commands.name: commands
commands.summary: List every command with its access and whether it reads input.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Print this help. The flag --help does the same.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Print the version. The flag --version does the same.

flags.meaning: Read the script or other input from this file instead of stdin.
Use this SQLite file instead of $AMBITIOUS_HOME/video/video.sqlite.
For plan, estimate, render, cache list and cache prune: use this step cache folder instead of $AMBITIOUS_HOME/video/cache.
For plan, estimate and render: call no provider and need no key. Every paid step takes its free fallback (speech becomes captions only), is marked with fallback, and costs 0.
For cache prune: remove entries last used more than this many whole days ago, 0 to 36500.
Use this time instead of the clock, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
Use this seed for anything random, such as a job id.
Accepted for compatibility. Output is always JSON.
Print this help as envelope data and exit 0. -h does the same.
Print the version as envelope data and exit 0.

help.start: Run the guide command, save data.example.script to a file, then validate and render that file.

example.name: titles-and-captions.yaml
example.needs: No media files and no API key.

steps: Save data.example.script as video.yaml in an empty folder.
Write { "jobId": "<data.jobId from render>" } to job.json, then: ambitious-video verify --in job.json
keys: Keys are bring-your-own. A paid step reads its provider's key from one environment variable, only for a call that is not in the step cache yet. The key value is never written to the database, the cache, the plan, the ledger, a log or any output.

Before a render, run estimate (or plan) and read data.secretsNeeded. It has one entry per environment variable that is not set and that an uncached paid step needs: env, provider, steps and usd. It is empty when every key is set or every paid step is cached, and it never holds a key value.

An assistant that renders for an owner shows the estimate first and renders only after the owner agrees to the cost. It asks the owner once for each env in data.secretsNeeded, through the host's secure secret or environment mechanism, and sets the variable only in the environment of the render command.
A key must never be put in a script, a file, a chat message, a page, a log or a command line. Do not ask for a key that data.secretsNeeded does not list.
render checks every paid step before the first call. If a key is missing it stops with E_NO_KEY, data.missing lists the same entries, no provider is called and nothing is charged.

If the owner declines a key, or nothing may leave the computer, run plan, estimate and render again with --offline. Every paid step then takes its free fallback (speech becomes captions only), each such step is marked with fallback, the cost is 0.000000 and no provider is called. --offline replaces paid steps only: a screen_recording clip still opens the page it names.
notes: A voiceover clip is a caption only: nothing is spoken, no key is needed, and the estimate is 0. To have a line spoken, use a speech clip that names a provider, a model and a voice, and set that provider's key in the environment. The estimate then shows the price and its source.

Captions are drawn only by a track with from: <id of a track with voiceover or speech clips>. Each such clip is shown during its own time, one sentence at a time. A script with no such track draws no captions.
Paths in a script are relative to the folder that holds the script. The video is written to output.path in that folder.
brand.font must be the path of a font file next to the script, such as fonts/name.ttf. A font name is rejected, because fonts installed on one computer are not on another.
output.encode is web by default: H.264 with yuv420p pixels, which browsers play. Set output.encode: lossless for an exact RGB file whose bytes repeat for the same script.
